correctness.rationale: Over R=F_q[epsilon]/(epsilon^2), nilpotence of a 2x2 matrix is equivalent to nilpotence of its residue and there are q^6 nilpotent matrices. Rank-one idempotents number q^3(q+1), including q^2 lifts per field projection. Conditioning on rank of the residue and determinant in R partitions target matrices exhaustively into eight cases. For primitive determinant-zero targets the residue constraints y=s x-a and (a s-b)x=a^2 give q or q-1 choices of s and q^3 lifts, yielding q^4+1 or (q-1)q^3. Radical and zero cases follow by rank-one projection geometry. Transposition preserves invariants and swaps order EN/NE. Independent FULL enumeration over F_2 dual numbers finds 26 idempotents, 64 nilpotents, 1664 pairs in each order, 112 positive targets and exact fiber multiplicities matching all predicted cases. This is one finite-field check, not an unrestricted proof.
